In reply to this submission Mr GM Mozahidur Rahman, the learned advocate appearing for the opposite party submits that in the plaint RoR khatian has shown as 2291 wherein the land has sought to bear area of 261/2 decimals of land but since it was mistakenly typed, by way of amendment, the plaintiff tried to introduce the fact that the RoR khatian was in fact 2221 instead of 2291 and accordingly the area of the suit land would be 0.19¼ acres instead of 26½ decimals of land as shown earlier in the plaint but so far the boundaries is concerned there is no change it was remain as it is: 

 17. This is a suit for declaration of title. In that suit an application for amendment was sought for by the plaintiff. From the submission of the opposite party as well as going through the plaint and the amendment application it would be noticed that plaintiff sought ROR amendment on some mistakes in the ROR khatian.
